searchText: I'm having some issues with the devnet-6 RPC on <https://rpc.pectra-devnet-6.ethpandaops.io/>. I'm trying to send devnet-6 ETH or perform transaction and it just fails. How are you sending the tx? Are you sure that certain params like the `chainId` are correct? I was able to send transactions a few minutes ago. I also used the button to add the network to metamask on <https://pectra-devnet-6.ethpandaops.io/>. It seems to be back now 👍 Could it be some spam protection? I can send like 1-3 transactions after which they just all fail for some reason. We switched to using erpc not too long ago, i think its having some growing pains :/ could you try it out again? Hey <@199561711278227457> , I'm setting up my own testnet following this: https://github.com/ethpandaops/template-devnets Sadly I ran into this error after running `terraform apply` ```hcloud_server.main["lodestar-geth-1-arm"]: Creating... hcloud_server.main["lighthouse-geth-1-arm"]: Creating... ╷ │ Error: server limit exceeded (resource_limit_exceeded) │ │ with hcloud_server.main["lodestar-geth-1-arm"], │ on hetzner.tf line 125, in resource "hcloud_server" "main": │ 125: resource "hcloud_server" "main" { │ ╵ ╷ │ Error: server limit exceeded (resource_limit_exceeded) │ │ with hcloud_server.main["lighthouse-geth-1-arm"], │ on hetzner.tf line 125, in resource "hcloud_server" "main": │ 125: resource "hcloud_server" "main" { │ ``` Are there any recommended server limits to be followed? Also it seems Hetzner doesn't increase server limits for newer accounts 🥲 Yeah that's gonna depend on your account with hetzner :/ you'll have to login to the panel, see what limits you have and modify the size used accordingly. could someone send type 0x04 transactions on devnet-6? I don't think the chain has any I'd like to spin up a simple devnet-6 node to use as JSON RPC. I'm looking at client versions in <https://github.com/ethpandaops/pectra-devnets/blob/master/ansible/inventories/devnet-6/group_vars/all/images.yaml> but they are all pointing to docker images I don't have access to. Is there a client list with links to branches or commits I can easily find that are used for devnet-6? I'm happy to recompile everything from those sources. you should have access to all those images 🙂 there is no authentication in front of that custom registry. If it still fails for some reason, cut off the `docker.ethquokkaops.io/dh/` prefix from the image name and you'll get them from docker hub as usual Great, let me try that. Hey <@199561711278227457> , I got some more questions 😅 . Can I dm you? I've started spamming some type 4 transactions 🙂 eg. https://dora.pectra-devnet-6.ethpandaops.io/slot/6866 but blockscout currently can't display them ah nice! Thank you when I do: ```json { "jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 0, "method": "eth_getBlockByHash", "params": ["0xfa1e45dd709e17fc54dfddcab28d857bc67386be653b7a790219375013c9537b", true] } ``` to <https://rpc.pectra-devnet-6.ethpandaops.io/> I don't get any type 4:s not sure where you got the blockhash from, but it's not the block I've sent you 😄 `curl -X POST -H "Content-Type: application/json" --data '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"eth_getBlockByHash","params":["0xeba31f06425b86065f8b1990b94108a3ebc1d3e455d0df59645b982876db0cb1", true],"id":1}' https://rpc.pectra-devnet-6.ethpandaops.io | jq` ah sorry, its the parents :P is it possible to get `eth_simulateV1` enabled on <https://rpc.pectra-devnet-6.ethpandaops.io/>? I get "method ignored by upstream: 94 upstream skipped" should be enabled now 🙂 hmm I get "method not found" now and when I tried again I got: `'eth_simulateV1' is not a registered RPC method` uhm, I kind of expected that tbh 😄 not all clients support that method and the load balancer doesn't know which client supports it geth and nethermind should 🤔
